buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web --output-dir web-dist --clear && node scripts/fix-web-html.js
_comment_rewrites: The last rule used to be { source: /(.*) } which sent EVERY unmatched path to index.html with
a 200. A typo'd or deleted file therefore came back as a working-looking page, and that trap
twice made a stale or absent file read as 'deployed'.
The source now excludes any path containing a dot, so a request for a FILE that does not exist
falls through to Vercel's own 404 instead of impersonating the app.
SPA routes are unaffected, and that is checked rather than assumed: tests/vercel-rewrites.test.ts
asserts every route the app navigates to still matches, and that dotted paths no longer do.
Measured: 0 of the app's routes contain a dot, and every shipped asset is a real static file,
which Vercel serves before rewrites are consulted.
